context: Kenji and Ren review the company system together.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: レン君、システム、本当、見直したい。
lines.en: Ren — I really want to go over the system with you.
lines.style: Warm, gentle opening. Small pause after the name. Slow, thoughtful pace. Genuine concern threaded through — not lecturing, offering. Steady eye contact energy in the voice.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.en: Yeah, it really does need looking at.
lines.style: Quiet agreement. Soft, attentive. Matching Kenji's warmth without echoing it — his own recognition landing gently. A slight lift at the end, like he's grateful to be heard.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: Let's figure it out together, okay?
lines.style: Invitation, not instruction. Open tone. Slow, reassuring. The 'together' carries weight — he's drawing Ren in as a partner. Warm and steady throughout.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.en: I'll do my best — I really will.
lines.style: Quiet commitment. Respectful undercurrent without sounding deferential. Slight breath before the second clause. Sincere, no performance. The warmth in his voice matches Kenji's but belongs to him.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Deep, genuine. Slight crack of vulnerability in the opening. Slow, deliberate. The 'always' lands soft but steady. Not casual gratitude — the real thing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.style: Matching Kenji's depth. Quiet, attentive. No rush. The words settle in the space between them. Small, authentic — not performing reciprocal warmth, feeling it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: From here on — I mean it.
lines.style: Closing warmth. A small pause after the dash. Gentle promise in the tone, not pressure. Steady and present. The 'I mean it' is quiet, certain, almost to himself.
